headline: Executive order aims to restore state, tribal, and local police access to certain federal equipment and resources.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order restores access for state, tribal, and local law enforcement agencies to equipment and resources that had been limited before. The title describes these as life-saving. No summary was provided, so the specific equipment, programs, and rules involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: State, tribal, and local law enforcement agencies
who_it_affects.how: They may regain access to equipment and resources that were previously restricted.

when_it_takes_effect: 2017-08-28 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in the material provided)
